newsitem.title: USA: Garden Botanika June sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Garden Botanika June sales rise.

text.p: Garden Botanika Inc on Wednesday reported that sales the five week fiscal period ended July 5, rose 44 percent to $9.21 million from $6.40 million in June 1996.
Store sales rose 54 percent on the strength of an increase from 180 to 267 in the number of stores and a 12 percent increase in comparable store sales.
it said mail order sales declined 46 percent on a planned reduction in circulation.
For the 22 weeks ended July 5, sales rose 46 percent to $41.86 million from $28.57 million in the year ago period.
